pages.title: Balance Score
pages.text: The $(thing)Balance Score$() on your Diet Screen measures how $(bold)evenly spread$() your six bars are — not how full they are.$(br2)$(c:#52c252)$(bold)1.0$()$() — all six bars are perfectly equal.$(br2)$(c:#e05252)$(bold)Near 0$()$() — your diet is heavily skewed toward one or two groups.

pages.title: Why It Matters
pages.text: Two players can have the same $(italic)average$() nutrition and completely different outcomes.$(br2)Proteins at $(c:#52c252)95%$() and Fruits at $(c:#e05252)5%$() averages the same as both at 50% — but only one of them has Unluck I.$(br2)$(bold)The Balance Score is your early warning system.$() Watch it trend downward and you know your diet is drifting $(italic)before$() the penalties arrive.
